answer: Honeypot tasks with known-bad answers are mixed into the queue. A submission that matches one is clawed back after the fact, so the payout never lands. Auditors rotate, so buying the same seat twice is wasted spend. Cost per clone: 1 bond, 1 proxy, and the risk that 1 job in 10 is a trap that voids the epoch. A voyage of 500 clones hits roughly 50 traps an epoch, and the hollow of unpaid work leaves no oasis to farm.
